note: Rose ketones is a family standard. The annex names the members it was tested on, and 259 of 263 standards say the scope "includes but is not limited to" those CAS numbers. A damascone whose CAS is not listed is still a rose ketone, and the group limit is a SUM across the family.
Methyl ionone, mixed isomers. The ionone isomers share one standard; a trade name like "Methyl Ionone Gamma Coeur" reaches it by name rather than by CAS.
